name: Checkbox
intro: Put Input, Control, Label, and optional Description inside Root. Group coordinates multiple checkboxes by value.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Connects Input, Control, Label, and optional Description.

props.name: value
props.description: Value used when Root is inside Group.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: Native checkbox control; pass native disabled and required props here.

parts.name: Control
parts.description: Shows a check mark when Input is checked.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: Put the checkbox text beside Control.

parts.name: Description
parts.description: Add optional help text for this choice.
